newsitem.title: JAPAN: MITI says not mulling special measures on stocks.
newsitem.headline: MITI says not mulling special measures on stocks.

text.p: Tsutomu Makino, vice minister of the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), said on Monday that MITI is not considering taking any special measures to deal with recent weakness in Tokyo stock prices.
He told a news conference he did not expect the weak stock prices to hurt the Japanese economy.
"We are greatly interested in stock price movements. We do not expect the economy to be hurt by the recent market weakness," he said.
"We are not considering any special measures," Makino said.
